patch.value: Preserve opted-in Beads extensions with versioned sidecars and explicit loss reports

Acceptance: unknown nested fields survive import/export; conflicting native mappings refuse; size and privacy limits apply before mutation. Provide typed SDK and compact TOON/JSON command output, documentation and public-tracker copy validation without git.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Overlap check against the current CLI and sibling packages: core extension custom fields provide schema-owned values; beads diff compares mapped fields, and snapshot reconciliation manages mapped fields and acknowledged bases. pm-csv owns tabular column mapping. None preserves explicitly selected opaque Beads extension objects. Design: portable schema-1 sidecar capture before ordinary import, restore after ordinary export, keyed by exact external ids. Reuse native import/export and SDK atomic file writing and host rendering; never duplicate tracker mutation, settings, locking or mappings. Reject native field selection and overlay collisions. Report every unselected extension occurrence as loss; enforce bounded JSON and privacy policy before any output write. Sidecars stay separate from tracker items and must travel with the JSONL snapshot.
